build_emu3_conditional_generation: build an Emu3ForConditionalGeneration model for multimodal image-text generation with VQ-VAE encoding
encode_image_tokens_emu3vqvae: encode images into discrete VQ-VAE tokens using Emu3VQVAE encode method with pixel values and image sizes
decode_image_tokens_emu3vqvae: decode VQ-VAE image tokens back into continuous pixel values using Emu3VQVAE decode method
generate_text_emu3_for_causal_lm: generate text using Emu3ForCausalLM forward pass with input IDs and optional image features
map_image_tokens_bpe_emu3: map discrete image tokens to BPE tokens using Emu3ImageVocabularyMapping convert_img2bpe method
